def count_vowels(s):
    vowels = set('aeiou')
    count = 0
    for i, c in enumerate(s):
        if c in vowels:
            continue
        left_is_vowel = i > 0 and s[i-1] in vowels
        right_is_vowel = i < len(s) - 1 and s[i+1] in vowels
        if left_is_vowel or right_is_vowel:
            count += 1
    return count


assert count_vowels('bestinstareels') == 7
